analysis.summaryJa: このページはatを地図・時計・尺度・反応対象上の一点として捉え、beforeを時間・手順・順位で先にある関係として捉える。物理的な『前』を表すin front ofと、順序・権威の前を表すbeforeを区別する。
grammarPoints: atは場所・時刻・速度・価格などの一点を示す
atは技能や反応が向かう対象を示す
beforeは基準時点より早いことを示す
beforeは作業手順や出来事の順序を示す
come beforeは優先順位、appear beforeは公的主体への出席を示す
visualEvidence: 地図上の一点と時計の一点がatに結び付く
速度計・価格表の目盛りがatの率を示す
タイムライン上でbeforeが基準点より左側に置かれる
作業カードの前後配置が手順順序を示す
人が委員会へ向き合う図がappear beforeを示す
commonTraps: atとinを場所の広さだけで選ぶ
beforeを物理的な正面位置に使う
beforeの後ろにto不定詞を置く
at＋動名詞の技能表現を見落とす
come beforeを時間だけと考え優先の意味を逃す

questions.prompt: The shuttle will collect conference guests ------- the north entrance.
questions.translationJa: シャトルは北口で会議参加者を乗せます。
questions.explanationJa: 入口を乗車地点という一点として示すためatです。

questions.prompt: The budget review begins ------- 10:00 sharp.
questions.translationJa: 予算審査は10時ちょうどに始まります。
questions.explanationJa: 時計上の特定の一点を示すためatを使います。

questions.prompt: The packaging line operates ------- a maximum speed of 60 units per minute.
questions.translationJa: 包装ラインは毎分最大60個の速度で稼働します。
questions.explanationJa: 速度・率という目盛り上の一点にはatを用います。

questions.prompt: Please submit the visitor list ------- noon on Monday.
questions.translationJa: 来訪者名簿は月曜日の正午前に提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: 締切より早い時点を指定するためbeforeが適切です。

questions.prompt: The safety inspection must occur ------- the equipment is restarted.
questions.translationJa: 安全検査は機器を再起動する前に行わなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの行為の順序で検査が先なのでbefore節を使います。

questions.prompt: Customer privacy should come ------- marketing convenience.
questions.translationJa: 顧客のプライバシーはマーケティング上の利便性より優先されるべきです。
questions.explanationJa: come beforeは順位・優先度で上位に置く意味です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Gomez is excellent ------- resolving complex billing disputes.
questions.translationJa: ゴメスさんは複雑な請求紛争の解決が得意です。
questions.explanationJa: be excellent at＋動名詞で技能の対象を示します。

questions.prompt: The witness will appear ------- the review panel next Tuesday.
questions.translationJa: 証人は来週火曜日に審査委員会へ出席します。
questions.explanationJa: appear before an authorityは公的機関・審査主体の前に出る意味です。

questions.prompt: The receptionist smiled ------- the child waiting with his father.
questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は父親と待つ子どもに微笑みかけました。
questions.explanationJa: smile atは反応・視線の対象という一点を示します。

questions.prompt: The revised procedure was tested ------- it was introduced company-wide.
questions.translationJa: 改訂手順は全社導入される前に試験されました。
questions.explanationJa: 導入より試験が先という出来事の順序をbeforeで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence identifying a precise meeting point.

choices.A: The sales team will meet before Gate 4 as a physical position.
choices.B: The sales team will meet at Gate 4.
choices.C: The sales team will meet at to Gate 4.
choices.D: The sales team will meet before to Gate 4.

questions.translationJa: 営業チームは4番ゲートで集合します。
questions.explanationJa: ゲートを集合地点として示すためatが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence identifying an exact clock time.

choices.A: The final train leaves before 11:42 p.m. exactly at that time.
choices.B: The final train leaves at to 11:42 p.m.
choices.C: The final train leaves at 11:42 p.m.
choices.D: The final train leaves in front of 11:42 p.m.

questions.translationJa: 最終列車は午後11時42分に出発します。
questions.explanationJa: 特定時刻にはatを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing a price rate.

choices.A: The rooms are offered before $120 per night.
choices.B: The rooms are offered at to $120 per night.
choices.C: The rooms are offered in front of $120 per night.
choices.D: The rooms are offered at $120 per night.

questions.translationJa: 客室は1泊120ドルで提供されています。
questions.explanationJa: 価格・料金という尺度上の値にはatが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence requiring action earlier than a deadline.

choices.A: Please reply before the close of business.
choices.B: Please reply at the close of business and earlier only.
choices.C: Please reply before to the close of business.
choices.D: Please reply in front of the close of business.

questions.translationJa: 営業時間終了前に返信してください。
questions.explanationJa: 基準時点より前という期限関係をbeforeが示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence placing one task earlier in a sequence.

choices.A: Back up the database at installing the update.
choices.B: Back up the database before installing the update.
choices.C: Back up the database in front of installing the update.
choices.D: Back up the database before to install the update.

questions.translationJa: 更新版をインストールする前にデータベースをバックアップしてください。
questions.explanationJa: before＋動名詞で、先に行う手順を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence expressing priority rather than physical position.

choices.B: Accuracy must stand in front of speed physically.
choices.C: Accuracy must come before to speed.

questions.translationJa: 正確さは速さより優先されなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: come beforeは抽象的な順位で優先する意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing ability.

choices.A: Mr. Bell is skilled before negotiating service contracts.
choices.B: Mr. Bell is skilled at to negotiate service contracts.
choices.C: Mr. Bell is skilled at negotiating service contracts.
choices.D: Mr. Bell is skilled in front of negotiating service contracts.

questions.translationJa: ベルさんはサービス契約の交渉が得意です。
questions.explanationJa: be skilled at＋動名詞が技能分野を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing attendance in front of an official body.

choices.A: The contractor testified before the city council.
choices.B: The contractor testified at the city council as a clock point.
choices.C: The contractor testified before to the city council.
choices.D: The contractor testified in front the city council.

questions.translationJa: 請負業者は市議会で証言しました。
questions.explanationJa: testify before an official bodyはその審議主体に対して証言する表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence directing attention toward a target.

choices.A: The trainer pointed before the damaged cable in time.
choices.B: The trainer pointed at the damaged cable.
choices.C: The trainer pointed at to the damaged cable.
choices.D: The trainer pointed before to the damaged cable.

questions.translationJa: 講師は損傷したケーブルを指さしました。
questions.explanationJa: point atは指示・視線の対象を一点として捉えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence saying approval preceded publication.

choices.A: The legal team reviewed the notice at it was published.
choices.B: The legal team reviewed the notice in front of it was published.
choices.C: The legal team reviewed the notice before it was published.
choices.D: The legal team reviewed the notice before was it published.

questions.translationJa: 法務チームは案内が公表される前に確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: before節は通常の主語＋動詞語順で、出来事の先後を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Meet us at the ticket counter."

choices.A: Stand physically before the counter but not at it.
choices.B: Meet before the counter opens, regardless of place.
choices.C: Use the ticket counter as the meeting point.

questions.translationJa: 券売カウンターを集合地点にしてください。
questions.explanationJa: atは場所を一点の目印として指定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The call starts at 8:15."

choices.A: The call starts at any time before 8:15.
choices.B: The call lasts for 8 hours and 15 minutes.
choices.C: The call is physically in front of a clock.
choices.D: 8:15 is the exact starting time of the call.

questions.translationJa: 通話の正確な開始時刻は8時15分です。
questions.explanationJa: at＋時刻は時計上の一点を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The vehicle was traveling at 40 kilometers per hour."

choices.A: Its speed was 40 kilometers per hour.
choices.D: It stopped in front of 40 kilometers.

questions.translationJa: 車両の速度は時速40キロでした。
questions.explanationJa: atは速度の目盛り上の値を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Send the file before Friday."

choices.A: Send the file exactly at some unspecified Friday time.
choices.B: Send the file no later than Thursday.
choices.C: Display the file in front of a Friday calendar.

questions.translationJa: 遅くとも木曜日までにファイルを送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: before Fridayは金曜日開始より前を意味します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Inspect the seal before opening the package."

choices.A: Inspect the seal while the package is already open.
choices.B: Place the seal physically in front of the package.
choices.C: First inspect the seal, and then open the package.

questions.translationJa: 先に封印を確認し、その後で荷物を開けてください。
questions.explanationJa: beforeは手順の順序を指定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Quality comes before cost."

choices.A: Quality has a higher priority than cost.
choices.B: Quality is located physically in front of cost.
choices.C: Quality is measured at a cost point.
choices.D: Cost has a higher priority than quality.

questions.translationJa: 品質は費用より優先されます。
questions.explanationJa: come beforeは抽象的な優先順位を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "She is good at customer follow-up."

choices.A: She contacts customers only before work.
choices.B: She stands at a customer location.
choices.C: She places follow-up physically before customers.
choices.D: She handles follow-up with customers skillfully.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は顧客へのフォローが得意です。
questions.explanationJa: be good atは技能・活動への習熟を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The executive appeared before the committee."

choices.A: The executive arrived earlier than every committee member only.
choices.B: The executive formally presented himself to the committee.
choices.C: The executive stood at an unrelated location.
choices.D: The executive placed a committee physically behind him.

questions.translationJa: 役員は委員会に正式に出席しました。
questions.explanationJa: appear beforeは権限を持つ組織の審理・聴取に出ることです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Everyone laughed at the unexpected slogan."

choices.A: Everyone laughed before reading the slogan.
choices.B: Everyone laughed at an exact time called the slogan.
choices.C: The slogan was the target that caused everyone's laughter.
choices.D: The slogan was physically in front of everyone.

questions.translationJa: その意外な標語が皆の笑いの対象になりました。
questions.explanationJa: laugh atは反応の向かう対象を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The samples were approved before shipment."

choices.B: Approval and shipment occurred at exactly the same time.
choices.D: The samples were placed in front of a truck.

questions.translationJa: 見本の承認は出荷より先に行われました。
questions.explanationJa: beforeは二つの出来事の時間順序を表します。

questions.prompt: The driver cannot enter the building. Please wait ------- the employee entrance for pickup.
questions.translationJa: 運転手は建物に入れません。迎えのため従業員入口で待ってください。
questions.explanationJa: 入口を待ち合わせ地点として指定するのでatです。

questions.prompt: The webinar invitation says '14:00 JST.' It will begin ------- exactly that time.
questions.translationJa: ウェビナー案内には日本時間14時とあります。まさにその時刻に始まります。
questions.explanationJa: exactly that timeが特定時点を示すためatです。

questions.prompt: The machine's normal rate is 300 bottles per hour. Keep it running ------- that rate.
questions.translationJa: 機械の通常速度は毎時300本です。その速度で稼働させてください。
questions.explanationJa: 稼働率という尺度上の値を示すatが適切です。

questions.prompt: The office closes at six, and security needs the list in advance. Submit it ------- 5:30.
questions.translationJa: 事務所は6時に閉まり、警備は事前に名簿が必要です。5時30分より前に提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: 5時30分そのものではなく、それより早い期限なのでbeforeです。

questions.prompt: The replacement battery is disconnected now. Read the warning label ------- connecting it.
questions.translationJa: 交換電池は現在未接続です。接続する前に警告ラベルを読んでください。
questions.explanationJa: 安全上、読む行為を接続より先に置くためbeforeです。

questions.prompt: The team is under schedule pressure, but passenger safety has the highest priority. It must come ------- speed.
questions.translationJa: チームは日程上の圧力を受けていますが乗客安全が最優先です。速さより優先されます。
questions.explanationJa: 抽象的な優先関係なのでcome beforeを用います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Novak consistently resolves complaints without escalation. She is very effective ------- calming upset customers.
questions.translationJa: ノヴァクさんは苦情を上位対応にせず解決します。怒った顧客を落ち着かせるのが非常に得意です。
questions.explanationJa: effective at＋動名詞で技能・効果の出る活動を示します。

questions.prompt: The supplier dispute is being formally investigated. Both companies will present evidence ------- an arbitration panel.
questions.translationJa: 仕入先紛争は正式調査中です。両社は仲裁委員会に証拠を提示します。
questions.explanationJa: 正式な審理主体に対して出るためbefore an arbitration panelです。

questions.prompt: The map contains many symbols. The guide is pointing ------- the blue triangle that marks reception.
questions.translationJa: 地図には多くの記号があります。ガイドは受付を示す青い三角を指しています。
questions.explanationJa: 多数の中の具体的な対象へ指を向けるためatです。

questions.prompt: The advertisement cannot go live until Legal signs it. Legal review must happen ------- publication.
questions.translationJa: 法務の署名までは広告を公開できません。法務確認は公表前に行う必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: reviewがpublicationより先という順序を示すbeforeが適切です。
